hero.title: Savor the Rich Heritage of Indian Cuisine at Hermitage India
hero.subtitle: Where time-honored recipes meet contemporary elegance, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

about.title: The Essence of Indian Hospitality
about.paragraph1: At Hermitage India, we invite you on a culinary journey designed to tantalize your taste buds and transport you to the vibrant streets of India. Our passion lies in crafting authentic Indian dishes, blending traditional recipes with fresh, high-quality ingredients sourced with care and expertise.
about.paragraph2: From the aromatic curries and tandoor-baked breads to our exquisite selection of vegetarian and non-vegetarian specialties, every plate is a celebration of India's rich culinary heritage. We strive to create a warm, inviting atmosphere where every meal is more than just food – it's an experience shared with friends and family, embodying the true spirit of Indian hospitality.
